summary: Implemented Graph.cbd in rdflib/graph.py (last Graph method, before ConjunctiveGraph) with a nested add_to_cbd helper implementing the W3C CBD rules: subject triples, recursive blank-node expansion guarded by the result's existing subject triples, and reification of every node described (no rdf:Statement or predicate/object check). Added test/test_graph_cbd.py with class CbdTestCase covering the rule counts, typed/untyped reifiers, incoming-reification exclusion, blank-node non-expansion via reifiers, blank-node cycles, and source immutability. Nothing was run, as instructed; the expected counts were hand-computed from my own fixtures, so the tests are unverified. Nothing was committed. The docstring numbers rules per W3C (rule 2 is blank-node recursion, rule 3 is reification), which differs from the spec's step labels.
